question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **"abjectly."**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Abjectly" **expresses a degraded or low state. (निकृष्टतापूर्वक)
 
• It fits here as the white youngster act subserviently. This word contrasts with the dark boy's superior behavior..
 
 
• **Example**: The administration had failed **abjectly **in its duty to protect the country.
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.
 
• Correct passage:

To my utter astonishment,__ the little dark boy was striding __imperiously__ up and down the lawn while the white youngster walked __**abjectly**__ behind him. “Get me a banana!” The little boy ran ______ (4) ______ the house and ______ (5) ______ shortly.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Obviously"** means

 in a way that is easily perceived or understood; clearly. 
 (स्‍पष्‍ट रूप से)
 
• **"Definitely"** means without a doubt or certainly. (पक्‍के तौर पर; निस्‍संदेह)
 
• **"Eventually"** means at some point in the future or after some time has passed. (अंत में; अंततोगत्‍वा)
